meta.title: Bookshelf Exchange — a readers' exchange library
meta.description: A library readers trade between themselves: show the copy you have finished, find the one you have been hunting for, and talk it over before the book changes hands.

hero.title: Every book deserves a second reader
hero.lede: Small shelves traded between readers: show the copy you have finished, find the one that belongs on your shelf, and talk with its keeper before the book passes from hand to hand.

home.p01b: Record the book you have finished: its condition, its price if you sell it, or what you would swap it for.
home.p02b: Browse other readers' shelves and search by title, author, or ISBN.
home.p03b: Agree on a meeting or a delivery, then rate the exchange; trust is built one trade at a time.
home.colophon: Bookshelf Exchange — a readers' exchange library, open to all
home.localeNote: In Arabic and English, right to left and left to right.

auth.signUpIntro: One step from your first exchange, and a new shelf starts here.

addBook.title: Add a book
addBook.lede: Enter an ISBN and we will fetch the record from Open Library, or enter the details yourself.
addBook.searchIntro: We will fill in the record, then you review it before saving.
addBook.isbnHint: Ten or thirteen digits, with or without hyphens.
addBook.manualIntro: Enter the details exactly as they should appear in the catalogue.
addBook.invalidIsbn: That ISBN is not valid. Check the digits and try again.
addBook.rateLimited: Too many lookups in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
addBook.notFoundTitle: We could not find this book in Open Library
addBook.notFoundBody: No matter — enter its details yourself and it will stay on our shelves.
addBook.unavailableTitle: Open Library is unreachable right now
addBook.unavailableBody: Enter the details manually; we will save them exactly as you write them.
addBook.gateTitle: Sign in to add a book
addBook.gateBody: Adding is open to registered readers, so every book stays attributed to the person who entered it.
addBook.formIntro: Review the record before saving; every field can be edited.
addBook.authorsHint: Up to ten authors, in the order printed on the cover.
addBook.subjectsHint: Separate them with commas, up to twelve subjects.
addBook.coverFallbackNote: Without a ready cover we draw a typographic cover at 2:3.
